candidate.basis: Parent supplied candidate identity, matched by the preserved installation resource receipt and actual installed file hashes

actualReadReview.judgment: The installed instructions preserve the explicit site versus read-only guide boundary, six-step task-based work, Chinese explanations and activities with stable English core names, strict unanswered decisions, local resource locators and independent output, actual Sites version/access checks, and separate Owner acceptance and NOT_MEASURED learning effects. Package provenance links are described as traceability rather than runtime inputs.
actualReadReview.contentJudgment: LIB1 scopes one book and one renewal, with account categories explicitly not a process. LIB2 requires both not overdue and no other reservation: all four displayed combinations agree. LIB3 extends the original due date by seven calendar days only on success; 2026-10-29 plus seven is 2026-11-05, failure preserves 2026-10-29. LIB4 requires success wording and an updated due date together, and does not turn missing confirmation into failure or invent a timeout. Three local correct indices [1,0,1], feedback, references and source locators preserve these conditions. Core names and Chinese explanations are consistent in this bounded material; no real library policy or learner outcome is inferred.
actualReadReview.provenanceLimit: This consumer read the installed provenance and verified source bytes within the representative package. It did not independently fetch all upstream research or adjudicate licenses; those are separate source/provenance review evidence.

visualReview.judgment: Both initial viewports are readable with the warm-paper and terracotta theme, visible Chinese/English hierarchy, no visible severe cropping or horizontal overflow. Mobile text reflows within the viewport; desktop heading no longer leaves the final single character on its own line. This is a bounded initial-state visual review, not all-page/all-state or full accessibility certification.

clipboardQualification.realSuccess: Unmodified native Clipboard writeText completed, success UI appeared, and native readText returned the entire expected record. Windows changed 55 LF line endings to CRLF; all other content matches exactly. Raw readback, raw and normalized hashes are preserved. No byte-identical LF claim is made.
clipboardQualification.recovery: Separate real-browser fault injection rejected writeText and then removed the API. Both selected the complete manual text and exposed a visible return path; Escape or the return button restored copy-button focus. Manual-copy completion remained UNCONFIRMED.
clipboardQualification.priorFailure: Run01 consumer-report.json remains FAIL for its initial strict-byte clipboard comparison. The later run changes only the temporary QA comparison to account explicitly for Windows newline representation; runtime bytes and functional acceptance were not changed.

handoff.contents: Only index.html, local CSS/JS, artifact.json, authored Markdown, the explicitly listed original source, and artifact-manifest.json. Export and QA records remain outside the production artifact.
